newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM appoints corporate information officer.
newsitem.headline: KLM appoints corporate information officer.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines has appointed Max Rens as the airline's Corporate Information Officer, effective June 1.
Rens, aged 50, will also be a member of the company's Executive Management Team. He will advise the KLM board on the airline's information technology policy.
Rens will also be responsible for KLM Information Services (KIS) and for Corporate Information Management.
Previously, Rens was a board member of Netherlands Rail Infra Services. He has also worked for Fokker, DAF and Volvo. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
